models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Benign night at Portorosa - light southerlies, under 1 ft of swell; no new leg forecast in the payload for tomorrow.
briefing.synopsis: Light, rotating winds dominate the archipelago with no organised gradient: ECMWF IFS (08 Oct 18Z), AIFS and ICON-2i (both 09 Oct 00Z) all keep means in the 2-6 kt band through tonight, with direction swinging from E/ESE this evening into SW overnight and W by midday tomorrow. The 10 Oct 00Z hour at Portorosa is a genuine model split - consensus 5.5 kt but the models range 1.7 to 11.2 kt, so treat the mean as soft. From Saturday 11 Oct a NW flow fills in: Salina 11.3 kt at 06:00 (range 8.0-14.7) backing to 315 degrees with waves to 3.5 ft by midday, Filicudi 13.0 kt and 3.7 ft - that is the next real change in the pattern.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight is Portorosa Marina, the only listed option and the recommendation - enclosed basin, all-round shelter, so berth choice does not matter. Forecast at the berth is 3.8 kt from the S, gusting 13.4, with 0.9 ft of WNW swell outside. Overnight at the marina the consensus goes 5.5 kt SW at midnight and 5.7 kt SSW at 06:00 with gusts to 17.5 kt and wave 1.4 ft; nothing in that would move the fleet.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Friday 10 Oct looks light at Portorosa - around 5.7 kt SSW at 06:00 easing to 2.0 kt W by midday, gusts 11-17 kt, wave 1.3-1.4 ft. The payload lists Portorosa again as the 10 Oct berth and contains no leg forecast for tomorrow, so I cannot give you a departure window or passage numbers for the next leg - I do not have them. If a leg is added, note that the broader area stays light all day Friday and the weather window closes with the NW build early Saturday.

passage_notes.note: Today's leg, graded go with a 06:00 recommended start: 4.3 kt WSW, 0.7 ft, beam reach on the early window, deteriorating after 14:00 - the 14:00 departure was flagged no-go for thunderstorms in the passage window, not for wind.

cautions: Several interval-maximum gust figures look wild against very light means - Filicudi 59.7 kt gust at 18:00 today on a 9.2 kt mean (models range 2.6-19.0), Stromboli 43.3 kt and Lipari 40.6 kt at 06:00 tomorrow. These are IFS/ICON-2i interval maxima in light air, but they sit alongside today's thunderstorm flag, so treat them as a convective-gust signal and keep an eye to the west after dark.
Lipari at 06:00 tomorrow is a wide split: 11.6 kt consensus but models range 4.9-21.6 kt. If anyone is moving in the northern group, re-check the 12Z runs before casting off.
Saturday 11 Oct brings NW 11-13 kt and 3-3.7 ft seas across Salina, Filicudi and Stromboli - plan the back end of the week around it.
briefing.confidence_note: Short-lead wind speeds have been stable (mean shift 1.9 kt at 12-24 h), but direction has wandered an average of 41 degrees at that lead and the models disagree by up to 9 kt on the overnight hours at Portorosa.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
